Group Risk Management Policy

GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 20. Policy exceptions and waivers

## 20.1 Principle and requirements

Exceptions are permitted only where compliance is notachievablewithin therequired timeframe andwhere residual exposureis understood,mitigated and acceptedby anauthorised approver. An exception is a temporary,documented deviation;it is nota permanent alternative to compliance,and it does not alter therequirement itself.

| ATTRIBUTE | REQUIREMENT |
|---|---|
| Requestor | Namedindividual at Directorlevel oraboveaccountablefortheaffectedactivity |
| Requirement affected | Specific clause of this policy or ofa subordinate standard |
| Business justification | Why compliance cannot be achieved within the reguiredtimeframe |
| Risk assessment | Residual rating ofthe exposure created,assessed using Section11 |
| Compensating controls | Specific controls operating during the exception period, with named owners |
| Remediation plan | Datedplanto achievecompliance,orarationaleforpermanentvariance |
| Expiry date | Mandatory. Exceptions expire automaticallyandare not renewed bydefault |
| Approver | Assetout inSection7.8.determinedbytheresidualrating |

20.2 Exception register extract —open at 30 June 2026

| EXC-2025-118 | 16.1-next-day incidentreporting, Maniladesk | BienvenidoT.Salcedo(MER- PH-2214) | +639175550119 | Elevated | 31/07/2026 (ext.3) |

## 20.3Administration

All exceptions are recorded in the Group Exception Register maintained by the Group Risk function. The register is reported to the extended more than once, and any that have expired without remediation. Operating under sm expired exception is a policy breach. Group Executive Risk Committee monthly and to the Board Risk Committee quarterly, including total count, ageing profile, exceptions

No exception is availablefrom a legal or regulatoryrequirement,from a zero-appetite statement, or from theincidentreporting obligation inSection16.1.Where compliance with a legal requirement is not achievable,the matter is escalated immediately to the Group GeneralCounsel (R.M.Achterberg,r.achterberg@cadencefg.com)andthe BoardRiskCommittee.

## 21.Assurance,training and awareness

## 21.1 Assurance @uai the framework

Group Internal Audit reviews the design and operating effectiveness of the enterprise risk management framework at least once every two years and reports its opinion to the Audit Committee and the Board Risk Committee. The Group CRO additionally presents em annual framework effectiveness review to the Board covering governance, appetite, process, data, systems, resourcing and culture, stating explicitly any areas where the framework is not yet operating as intended.
